程序包 com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles

类 ParticleController

java.lang.Object
com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.particles.ParticleController
所有已实现的接口:
ResourceData.Configurable, com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Json.Serializable
public class ParticleController extends Object implements com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Json.Serializable, ResourceData.Configurable
Base class of all the particle controllers. Encapsulate the generic structure of a controller and methods to update the particles simulation.
